name: GitHub MCP
summary: External GitHub connector capability for repository, issue, pull request, review, and CI metadata operations when approved.

source.sourceName: GitHub MCP or GitHub plugin connector
source.notes: Connector entry for GitHub operations. It does not replace gh CLI fallback or repository approval gates.

useWhen: A ticket requires GitHub PR metadata, review comments, CI state, repository issue context, or PR lifecycle actions.
The action is approved by the ticket or current thread approval.
doNotUseWhen: The requested action would merge, close, delete, or mutate repository state without approval.
Local git or gh CLI is the safer source of truth for current workspace state.
routing.fallback: Use local git and gh CLI when connector access is unavailable; record fallback in handoff.

inputs.name: repositoryOrPrReference
inputs.description: Repository, branch, issue, or PR reference.

outputs.name: githubState
outputs.description: PR metadata, review status, CI state, comments, or links.

schemas.notes: Future adapter contract may normalize PR review and CI status payloads.

allowedOperations: Open or merge PRs only when approved
forbiddenOperations: Bypass branch protection without recorded approval
Delete branches or repositories without explicit request

cost.costDriver: GitHub workspace usage only unless external billing is introduced.

risks.description: GitHub connector actions can mutate repository collaboration state.
risks.mitigation: Require assigned ticket scope, current-thread approval for gated actions, and PR handoff logging.

governance.dataBoundary: Do not expose secrets, tokens, customer data, or private evidence in PR comments.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: Do not use connector actions to override review, approval, or branch governance without recorded approval.
governance.loggingRequirement: Record PR URL, review status, checks, merge commit, and fallback path if used.
governance.updatePolicy: Update when GitHub connector permissions or branch policy changes.

review.reviewNotes: Pilot connector entry with approval-gated mutation.

examples.scenario: A PR needs review comments inspected before merge.
examples.expectedUse: Use GitHub MCP or gh CLI to read comments and summarize actionable findings.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not merge or dismiss findings without satisfying review and approval rules.
